messages:
Morgan H: Quick heads-up: scheduling a staggered maintenance tonight for rack cohort az24-east-2c, 02:00-04:00 UTC. Thermal sensors showed recurring spikes after yesterday's load test; plan is controlled cooldown + soft drain to avoid mass preemptions. :thermometer: 
Sanjay P: SGTM. Which pools are impacted and any customer-facing capacity impact?
Morgan H: Affected pools: pool-gpu-highmem-3 (primary) and pool-gpu-standard-7 (backfill). Expect ~10-12% capacity reduction in that AZ during the window. No planned API downtime; requests will route to other AZs where possible.
Ellie R: Can we run a tiny canary first (2 nodes) to validate KV cache reseed times? Last reseed added ~180ms p99.
Morgan H: Yes. Canary -> 10-node cohort -> full cohort. Canary at 02:00, cohort ramp at 02:10. Abort if reseed p99 > 400ms.
Rafa: FYI please disable scheduled batch jobs to that pool from 01:50-04:30 so they don't hit cold caches.
Lena: Acknowledged. I'll add scheduler exclusion tags.
infra-oncall-bot: Reminder: ops playbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/playbooks/rack-thermal. Auto-page if >5% host failures in 5m.
Sanjay P: Dedicated customers pinned to pool-gpu-highmem-3? Need comms.
Morgan H: Two dedicated tenants: @acct-neo and @acct-cerebro. SEs have been notified and will send notices. We'll offer burst capacity in us-east-1 if necessary.
Ellie R: Runbook snippet:
```
# controlled drain
kubectl drain node-<id> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --pod-selector='app!=critical' --grace-period=120
```
Sanjay P: Who owns rollback? If temps don't fall after drains, do we rejoin nodes or keep warm-backfill?
Morgan H: Oncall (Lena) owns rollback decision + reheat monitor. Rollback if temps don't fall by 15% after 30m OR inference error rate >1%.
Lena: I'll run the monitor script and post updates here. Also enabling extra KPI dashboards (latency/cpu/gpu_temp).
Rafa: Cost note: burst capacity in other AZs will be ~1.4x unit cost for the window. Finance signed off for SLA preservation.
Sanjay P: Can we shift non-critical embedding jobs to low-priority batch to reduce burst?
Morgan H: Good call. Move embeddings jobs with tag "priority:low" to batch-west. Lena, can you coordinate with Batch SRE?
Lena: Pinging @batch-sre now; will escalate if no ack in 15m.
infra-oncall-bot: Deploybot: rolling-drain-script v2.3.1 scheduled at 02:00. Build: https://ci.redwood/builds/8723
Ellie R: I'll watch the canary. Abort if chat p95 increases >50ms.
Morgan H: Communication checklist: 1) SE emails to dedicated tenants (done), 2) status page update 30m before, 3) marketplace notices pending.
Sanjay P: I can push the status page blurb.
Morgan H: Please post: "Planned maintenance: az24-east-2c rack cooling and soft drain. No API downtime expected; potential capacity routing to other regions"
Lena: Canary started (02:00) 12: initial drains issued to node-az24-07 and node-az24-09.
Rafa: Observing temp delta: nodes dropped ~12% after fan ramp.
Ellie R: Canary p99 reseed = 210ms, p95 latency +18ms. Within thresholds. :thumbsup:
Morgan H: Proceeding with cohort ramp at 02:10. Executing staggered 5-node batches with 5m gap between batches.
infra-oncall-bot: cohort-ramp batch-2 started (02:15).
Lena: Batch-2 drains complete, KV cache backfill in us-east-1 in progress.
Sanjay P: Early telemetry shows a small spike in inference 5xxs (~0.3%). Monitoring.
Ellie R: Transient expected; watching traces for model-serving timeouts.
Rafa: Batch-3 started. Fan RPMs normalized on drained hosts.
Morgan H: 40m into window; temps down ~22% vs baseline. No rollback needed.
infra-oncall-bot: Status page will auto-post notice at 01:30 UTC prior to the window.
Lena: Final batch completed, starting slow rejoin sequence. No reboots needed; soft-drain + cooldown effective.
Sanjay P: Postmortem checklist: capture KV reseed timings, customer latency, and cost delta for burst.
Morgan H: I'll write an ops note and attach metrics snapshot. Closing thread after PM link. :white_check_mark:
